title: Register particulars of a charge (MR01)
text:
Use form MR01 to register particulars of a mortgage or charge created on or after 6 April 2013 for a UK registered company.

 File online with WebFiling to register your charge information as quickly as possible.

 It costs:

 • £14 to file your charge online

 • £24 to file a paper MR01 form

 It takes longer to process paper forms sent by post.

 Forms must be printed at full size on white A4 paper.

 Charges created before 6 April 2013

 Any particulars of a mortgage or charge created before 6 April 2013 must be registered on form MG01 (England and Wales, Northern Ireland) or form MG01s (Scotland) from The National Archives website .

 Archived forms may show incorrect fees. You’ll need to include the correct Companies House fees .
changeNote: Corrected fee to file a charge online.
